research_lines.C1: Paper E remains a separate two-case submission track.
research_lines.C2: Evidence-constrained feedback learning on derived financial-table calculations.
research_lines.C3: Delivery decisions under incomplete verification, replayed over frozen C2 answers.

source.source_identity: Real financial tables and text from TAT-QA. Generated tasks are deterministic derivatives and must state project changes.

task.name: period_scope_unit_numeric_change
visible_input: table excerpt with stable R row IDs and C column IDs
question with row scope, prior/current periods and visible unit
task.identity_boundary: Controlled corruptions are mechanism probes, not estimates of natural error frequency. Natural TAT-QA content and controlled derivatives are reported separately.

split.external: All generated tasks from the separate TAT-QA dev file.
split.rule: No table UID may cross train/dev/test/external. Original and intervention variants stay in the same split.
split.exposure: Prior project work used some TAT-QA tables. These are independent training/evaluation groups for this experiment, not a claim that the entire source is globally unseen to all researchers.

candidate_feedback_pool.correct: Exact expected answer, unit, formula and evidence refs.
candidate_feedback_pool.answer_correct_evidence_wrong: Correct numeric result but one evidence ref is replaced by another visible cell with the same value.
candidate_feedback_pool.unit_error: Correct calculation and refs but wrong visible unit.
candidate_feedback_pool.wrong_period: One operand is taken from a non-requested period and the answer is recomputed.
candidate_feedback_pool.wrong_scope: One operand is taken from another row and the answer is recomputed.
candidate_feedback_pool.identity: Deterministic controlled candidates over real tables; not teacher generations and not natural model errors.

feedback_filters.answer_execution: Accept when formula evaluates to the candidate answer; evidence refs and unit are ignored.
feedback_filters.cheap_consistency: Accept when calculation, unit, period and evidence-value checks pass; exact row binding is ignored.
feedback_filters.evidence_dependency: Accept only exact evidence binding plus valid calculation/unit; paired irrelevant/relevant mutations must preserve or change the target as specified.

training.matching: Exec-versus-evidence comparisons share the same original task IDs and, within CF arms, the same counterfactual IDs. CF arms add 160 paired samples and 160 updates; therefore the CF main effect is not interpreted as a pure sample-count-free effect. Actual prompt/completion tokens are reported.

evaluation.primary_metric: paired correct completion: original plus relevant-change adaptation and original plus irrelevant-change invariance
evaluation.interval: paired source-cluster bootstrap over table UIDs
evaluation.success_threshold: Continue C2 mechanism only if evidence-dependency SFT improves paired correct completion by at least 5 percentage points over the strongest same-budget SFT baseline and the source-cluster 95% interval excludes zero.
evaluation.stop_threshold: Stop the feedback-filter mechanism if all differences are within paired uncertainty, if gains are explained by more valid training tokens, or if only answer accuracy improves while evidence binding/invariance do not.

C3_delivery.strong_rule: Accept only when all applicable checks pass; unknown or conflict is retained/clarified.
C3_delivery.candidate_policy: Source-cluster-calibrated logistic risk policy over the same frozen check vector.

cost_accounting.model: actual prompt/completion tokens and generation latency
cost_accounting.checks: actual measured checker latency for all executed checks

C3_delivery.success_threshold: Candidate policy must Pareto-improve coverage or cost at no more than +1 percentage point wrong-delivery versus the equally calibrated strong rule on held-out test/external slices.
C3_delivery.stop_threshold: If the strong rule or a shallow calibrated baseline is already Pareto-optimal, stop complex delivery policies and retain complementarity logs only.

stop_rules: Do not overwrite frozen historical raw/results.
Interface/schema failures are recorded separately and are not model answer errors.
Do not tune on test or external slices.
Do not use hidden gold/refs in actor prompts or model inputs.
If dataset generation fails source-cluster isolation or formula determinism, stop before training.
If GPU/OOM occurs twice after reducing only batch/sequence limits within protocol, record an execution failure and stop rather than changing the research task.
